inputs.text: Listen to this from Bloomberg claiming energy prices are climbing every day with flights getting canceled and nonstop death and destruction all over the screens, so people everywhere are pushing to end the Iran war since it's poorly planned, unwinnable, and a threat to global stability. But not in Israel where the public is fully behind carrying it through. This is the hidden elites at work coordinating the whole mess to jack up energy costs for their profits while these reports create a fake global demand to stop it, advancing their real plan for resource control and tighter power. That contrast with Israel is no coincidence either—it's a deliberate split to keep populations divided and distracted from who's actually running the show.
